claims.statement: For full-column-rank M in F_2^{s x m} and arbitrary Boolean D(y), P(x,y)=(-1)^{x^TMy+a.x+b.y+c}D(y) has H(P)=2m and every finite adaptive/pruned restriction tree on P variables, with arbitrary disjoint Boolean terminal h, obeys U(Ph)-sum_l w_l U(P_l h)<=4 I_x(P). If s=m and M is invertible, U(P)=m, I_x(P)=m/2, and the constant improves to 2.
claims.quantifiers: All s>=m>=1; every full-column-rank binary M; all affine phases; every Boolean D without bias, complexity, or cylinder-count restriction; all finite adaptive/pruned physical restriction trees; every disjoint Boolean terminal h; base-2 units.

claims.statement: No dimension-independent retained-credit bound is proved for arbitrary coherent cores across positive-dimensional bilinear fibers or hierarchies lacking one fixed full-rank shield.
claims.delta: Removed every dependence on the number, overlap, bias, and internal complexity of defect cylinders in the full-column-rank regime; the surviving obstruction is now exactly positive fiber dimension.
